title: Oven Roasted Filipino Peanuts Kare Kare
description: A kid-friendly Filipino dish featuring charred and fluffy peanuts in a rich and savory sauce, this oven roasted version is a twist on the classic Kare Kare recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together peanut butter, fish sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the raw peanuts to the bowl and stir until they are evenly coated with the sauce.
Spread the peanuts out in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the peanuts in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until they are lightly browned and fragrant.
Remove the peanuts from the oven and stir in the water.
Return the peanuts to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 5 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the peanuts from the oven and let them cool completely on the baking sheet.
Serve the oven roasted peanuts hot, garnished with additional smoked paprika if desired.
